# KOV Career Agency: full question and answer set

> Independent, founder-led career representation and talent advisory service for senior and experienced professionals. Works for the candidate, never corporate HR. Scope agreed before work begins; fees agreed individually and confirmed in writing; enquiries free; no employment, interview or hiring outcome is promised. Contact: daniel@kovcareeragency.org. Site: https://kovcareeragency.org/

## Who KOV Career Agency Helps

### Can KOV Career Agency help Chief Executive Officers?
KOV works with senior and experienced professionals, and Chief Executive Officers are welcome to enquire. Fit and scope are assessed before work begins. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### Is private career representation suitable for Chief Financial Officers?
It can be, depending on goals and circumstances. Suitability for Private Career Representation is assessed during Assessment and Fit, and it is not offered automatically.

## Private Career Representation

### What is Assessment and Fit?
Assessment and Fit means discussing your objectives, constraints and the support you want, reviewing your background and target direction, checking whether representation suits you, and agreeing scope, responsibilities, approvals and communication.

### Why does Assessment and Fit matter in a career search?
Assessment and Fit means discussing your objectives, constraints and the support you want, reviewing your background and target direction, checking whether representation suits you, and agreeing scope, responsibilities, approvals and communication. A clear approach to this makes the rest of the search more focused.

### How does KOV handle Assessment and Fit?
Assessment and Fit means discussing your objectives, constraints and the support you want, reviewing your background and target direction, checking whether representation suits you, and agreeing scope, responsibilities, approvals and communication. Scope is agreed before work begins.

### Is Assessment and Fit part of Private Career Representation?
Assessment and Fit means discussing your objectives, constraints and the support you want, reviewing your background and target direction, checking whether representation suits you, and agreeing scope, responsibilities, approvals and communication. The exact scope for your case is agreed before work begins.

### Will I be consulted about Assessment and Fit?
KOV works with you directly. Responsibilities, approvals and communication are agreed up front, and you keep control of career decisions.

### Where does Assessment and Fit begin?
It begins with understanding your goals, background and target direction. Assessment and Fit means discussing your objectives, constraints and the support you want, reviewing your background and target direction, checking whether representation suits you, and agreeing scope, responsibilities, approvals and communication.

### Can I follow how Assessment and Fit is progressing?
KOV coordinates responses and next steps with you, and the way you are kept informed is agreed when scope is set.

### Does Assessment and Fit guarantee results?
No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

## Individual Career Services

### What is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization?
Resume and CV Writing & Optimization: Organises and sharpens a resume or CV so recruiters can quickly understand the professional's skills and experience. Scope is agreed before work begins.

### How does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization work at KOV Career Agency?
It starts by understanding your objective and confirming the right scope, followed by a tailored quotation. The work is then delivered and reviewed within the agreed revision process. Organises and sharpens a resume or CV so recruiters can quickly understand the professional's skills and experience.

### Who is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization for?
Resume and CV Writing & Optimization is for professionals who want this specific support without a full engagement. Fit is discussed when you enquire.

### What does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization include?
Organises and sharpens a resume or CV so recruiters can quickly understand the professional's skills and experience. Exact deliverables are clarified during the initial review and agreed before work begins.

### How much does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization cost?
KOV does not publish fixed prices. Fees are discussed once the service and deliverables are understood, and a tailored quotation is provided before work starts.

### How long does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization take?
The page does not state fixed turnaround times. Timing is discussed when the scope and deliverables are agreed.

### Is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization worth it for senior professionals?
It can be, if it addresses a real gap in how your background is presented or how your search is run. KOV discusses fit honestly before you commit. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### What do I need to provide to start Resume and CV Writing & Optimization?
Typically your current materials, your target roles and the outcome you want. KOV clarifies the information it needs during the initial review.

### Can Resume and CV Writing & Optimization be combined with Private Career Representation?
Private Career Representation and Individual Career Services are separate offerings, each discussed on its own scope and terms. Separate document or profile work is scoped as an Individual Career Service.

### Can I live abroad and still get Resume and CV Writing & Optimization from KOV?
Yes in most cases. KOV works remotely with professionals in global markets; availability depends on location and engagement fit, so contact KOV to confirm.

### Does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization guarantee interviews or a job?
No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### How do I request Resume and CV Writing & Optimization?
Send an inquiry through the contact page or email daniel@kovcareeragency.org. Individual Career Services are available through inquiry and quotation.

### Is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization confidential?
Confidentiality is the default at KOV, and your information is used only as agreed for the work.

### Can I get Resume and CV Writing & Optimization without Private Career Representation?
Yes. The seven Individual Career Services are offered separately and can be requested on their own.

### How are revisions handled for Resume and CV Writing & Optimization?
Work is reviewed and finalised within the agreed revision process, which is confirmed as part of the scope and quotation.

### What is the first step for Resume and CV Writing & Optimization?
The first step is understanding your objective, then confirming the right scope before a tailored quotation is provided.

### Is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization suitable for executives?
KOV works with senior and executive professionals. Suitability for your situation is discussed when you enquire.

### Is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization suitable for mid-career professionals?
It can be, depending on your goals. Fit and scope are discussed before work begins.

### Is Resume and CV Writing & Optimization useful for career changers?
It can help present transferable experience clearly for a new direction. Scope is tailored to your situation.

### Does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization help with remote job searches?
The work can be shaped around the roles and markets you are targeting, including remote or international ones. Scope is agreed in advance.

### Does Resume and CV Writing & Optimization help with international job searches?
It can be adapted to the market you are targeting. Confirm right-to-work and local requirements for each opportunity yourself.

## How KOV Works

### What is Onboarding?
In Onboarding, goals, target roles and search strategy are defined, and the resume and LinkedIn profile are rewritten.

### Why does Onboarding matter in a career search?
In Onboarding, goals, target roles and search strategy are defined, and the resume and LinkedIn profile are rewritten. A clear approach to this makes the rest of the search more focused.

### How does KOV handle Onboarding?
In Onboarding, goals, target roles and search strategy are defined, and the resume and LinkedIn profile are rewritten. Scope is agreed before work begins.

### Is Onboarding part of KOV's six-step process?
In Onboarding, goals, target roles and search strategy are defined, and the resume and LinkedIn profile are rewritten. The exact scope for your case is agreed before work begins.

### Will I be consulted about Onboarding?
KOV works with you directly. Responsibilities, approvals and communication are agreed up front, and you keep control of career decisions.

### Where does Onboarding begin?
It begins with understanding your goals, background and target direction. In Onboarding, goals, target roles and search strategy are defined, and the resume and LinkedIn profile are rewritten.

### Can I follow how Onboarding is progressing?
KOV coordinates responses and next steps with you, and the way you are kept informed is agreed when scope is set.

### Does Onboarding guarantee results?
No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### What is Job Applications?
Targeted applications are coordinated in line with the agreed strategy and your approval preferences.

### Why does Job Applications matter in a career search?
Targeted applications are coordinated in line with the agreed strategy and your approval preferences. A clear approach to this makes the rest of the search more focused.

### How does KOV handle Job Applications?
Targeted applications are coordinated in line with the agreed strategy and your approval preferences. Scope is agreed before work begins.

In Outreach, for each role applied to, the recruiter and hiring manager are contacted directly.

## Pricing and Fees

KOV does not publish fixed prices. Fees are agreed individually for the scope you choose and confirmed in writing before work begins.

### When do I find out about fees agreed in writing?
Terms are confirmed in writing before work begins. This is settled before any work begins.

Terms are confirmed in writing before work begins. The aim is no surprises, with terms confirmed in writing first.

No. Enquiries are free. Terms are confirmed in writing before work begins.

## General Questions and Cities

### Who is KOV the right fit for?
KOV works with senior and experienced professionals who want private career representation or specific individual career services. Suitability is assessed during Assessment and Fit.

### Is this coaching or done-for-you?
Private Career Representation is a managed service where KOV carries out research, positioning support and outreach on your behalf. Career Coaching is available separately as an Individual Career Service.

### Do you work for the company or for me?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR.

### How many clients do you take at once?
The number of active searches is deliberately capped so each client receives focused attention. Ask about current availability when you enquire.

### How fast can we start?
Timing depends on current availability and on agreeing scope. Contact KOV to discuss.

### How long does a search typically take?
Timelines vary with seniority, market and goals, and no timeline outcome is promised. KOV discusses realistic expectations with you.

### How involved do I need to be?
You stay in control of career decisions and approvals. KOV handles the execution of the agreed scope.

### Will I see every job before you apply?
Applications are coordinated in line with the agreed strategy and your approval preferences.

### How much does it cost?
KOV does not publish fixed prices. Fees are agreed individually for the scope you choose and confirmed in writing before work begins.

### How are individual career-service fees structured?
Individual Career Services are quoted on inquiry. Fees are discussed after the service and deliverables are understood, and a tailored quotation is provided before work starts.

### Are there long-term contracts?
Terms are confirmed in writing before work begins. Ask KOV about the structure of your agreed scope.

### What's not included?
Anything outside the agreed written scope is not included. Separate document or profile work is scoped as an Individual Career Service.

### Is my search confidential?
Confidentiality is the default at KOV.

### What if my current company asks?
KOV's outreach is planned and approved with you. Discuss your concerns up front so the approach respects your situation.

### Do you guarantee a job?
No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### What happens after I sign an offer?
You decide how to proceed, and KOV supports agreed follow-up and next steps.

### What is reverse recruiting?
Reverse recruiting is a service where an agent works for the job seeker instead of the employer. KOV Career Agency identifies target employers, maps the relevant decision-makers, and approaches them directly on the candidate's behalf.

### How does KOV Career Agency work?
KOV Career Agency is a founder-led practice. Every search is handled by a human: decision-maker research, personalised outreach, follow-up and direct introductions where appropriate, with no automated mass-applying.

### Does KOV Career Agency work with clients worldwide?
KOV works remotely with professionals in global markets. Service availability depends on location and engagement fit, so contact KOV to confirm for your location and goals.

### Who founded KOV Career Agency?
KOV Career Agency was founded by Daniel Ade, Founder and Principal Agent, who works directly with every client.

### How much does reverse recruiting cost?
KOV does not publish fixed prices. Fees are agreed individually for the scope you choose and confirmed in writing before any work begins, and enquiries are free.

### Is reverse recruiting worth it for executives?
It can be worthwhile for executives who want a confidential, time-efficient search, because research, outreach and follow-up are handled for them while they stay focused on their current role.

### What is the difference between a recruiter and a reverse recruiter?
A traditional recruiter is paid by an employer to fill a role. A reverse recruiter works for the candidate, researching target employers and approaching them on the candidate's behalf.

### Is a reverse recruiter the same as a career coach?
No. A career coach mainly advises and guides. A reverse recruiter also carries out target-company research, outreach and follow-up on the candidate's behalf.

### What is private career representation?
Private career representation is KOV's primary service. A dedicated agent represents a professional's search, from positioning and research through outreach, follow-up and preparation.

### What is a career agent?
A career agent represents a professional's career interests, similar to an agent in other industries, handling positioning, outreach and introductions for the client.

### What is a candidate representative?
A candidate representative acts for the job seeker, not the employer, managing outreach to target companies and supporting the candidate through the process.

### Can you find me a job?
KOV can run a structured search on your behalf, including research, positioning, outreach and follow-up, but no agency can guarantee a job. Employers make the hiring decisions.

### Do you guarantee a job offer?
No. KOV does not guarantee interviews or job offers because hiring decisions belong to employers. KOV commits to the agreed work, scope and communication.

### Can you find me a job in another country?
KOV can support international searches by researching employers, recruiters and hiring managers in your target country. Work authorisation and visa rules still apply and are the candidate's responsibility.

### Do you help with visa sponsorship jobs?
KOV can focus research on employers known to hire internationally. Sponsorship decisions are made by employers and depend on each country's immigration rules.

### Do you help professionals relocate abroad for work?
KOV supports the job search side of relocating, such as target-employer research and outreach. It does not provide immigration or legal advice.

### Can you help me work remotely for a company abroad?
Yes. KOV can target employers that hire remote professionals across borders and approach relevant hiring contacts on your behalf.

### What types of professionals does KOV work with?
KOV works mainly with senior professionals and executives across technology, finance, operations, legal and other fields.

### Do you work with mid-career professionals?
Yes, where there is a clear target and a good fit. Fit and scope are discussed before work begins.

### Do you work with lawyers and legal professionals?
KOV welcomes enquiries from legal professionals. Fit and scope are assessed before work begins, and no outcome is guaranteed.

### Is my job search kept confidential?
Confidentiality is the default at KOV. Outreach is planned and approved with you, and your details are shared only as agreed.

### Will my current employer find out I am looking?
KOV plans outreach with discretion and agrees approaches with you first, but no search can be risk-free. Discuss your concerns before work begins.

### Do you contact companies without my permission?
No. Outreach to relevant contacts happens where appropriate and approved by you.

### Do you apply to jobs for me?
Targeted applications are coordinated in line with the agreed strategy and your approval preferences, where appropriate and agreed.

### What is decision-maker mapping?
Decision-maker mapping is researching which people at a target employer influence hiring for a role, so outreach reaches the right person rather than a general inbox.

### What is the hidden job market?
The hidden job market refers to roles that are filled through networks, recruiter relationships or direct conversations without being widely advertised.

### How do I find unadvertised jobs?
Unadvertised roles are usually reached through target-company research, recruiter relationships and direct, professional outreach to hiring managers.

### What is target-company research?
Target-company research means identifying employers that fit your goals and understanding their needs, teams and hiring contacts before any outreach.

### What is a warm introduction?
A warm introduction is an approach through a mutual contact or a considered, personalised message, rather than a cold application through a job portal.

### How long does a reverse recruiting search take?
Timelines vary with seniority, market and goals. KOV discusses realistic timing with you at the start rather than promising a fixed date.

### How long does an executive job search take?
Executive searches commonly take several months, depending on level, sector, location and market conditions.

### What happens in the first conversation with KOV?
The work begins with an assessment of your goals, target roles, location preferences and timeline, and a discussion of fit and scope.

KOV follows six steps: auditing, positioning, extraction through targeted applications and outreach, interview preparation, negotiation support, and agreeing next steps.

### Can KOV help if I am not getting interviews?
KOV can review your story, materials and target roles to identify why a search may be stalling and plan a more focused approach.

### Why am I not getting replies from recruiters?
Common reasons include unclear positioning, a mismatch between target roles and experience, or applying through channels where many candidates compete. A focused review can help.

### Why is my executive job search taking so long?
Senior roles are fewer and often filled through relationships. A search can drag when it relies mainly on job boards rather than targeted research and outreach.

### Is it better to apply online or reach out directly?
Both can work. Direct, well-researched outreach to hiring contacts often complements online applications, especially for senior roles.

### How do I contact hiring managers professionally?
Research the right person, write a short, specific message that shows relevance, and follow up respectfully. KOV can handle this on your behalf.

### How do I get noticed by executive recruiters?
Clear positioning, an accurate LinkedIn profile and relevant outreach help. KOV can prepare and manage this for you.

### How do I find a headhunter in my industry?
Look for search firms that specialise in your sector and level. KOV can research and approach relevant recruiters for you.

## About KOV and the Founder

### What should I know about the founder profile?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service.

### Why does the founder profile matter to clients?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service. For clients, this means a more personal and accountable search.

### How does the founder profile shape the way KOV works?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service.

### Where can I learn more about the founder profile?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service. See the About page, or email daniel@kovcareeragency.org with questions.

### Is the founder profile relevant to my search?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service. Fit and scope are discussed before any work begins.

### Who is behind the founder profile?
The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service. KOV is founder-led by Daniel Ade.

### Can I ask Daniel about the founder profile directly?
Yes. Enquiries go straight to Daniel at daniel@kovcareeragency.org. The founder profile presents Daniel as the founder of KOV Career Agency, an independent career representation and talent advisory service.

### Does the founder profile promise any outcome?
No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

### What does KOV mean by working for the candidate?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR.

### Why does working for the candidate make KOV different?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR. This is part of what separates KOV from a large-volume service.

### How is working for the candidate different from a typical recruiter?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR. KOV represents the candidate rather than an employer.

### Is working for the candidate real or just marketing?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR. You can ask for details about how it works when you enquire.

### How does working for the candidate help my job search?
KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR.

KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR. Scope and fit are still agreed individually before work begins.

Yes. Enquiries are free, and scope and fit are discussed before work begins. KOV works for the candidate, never for corporate HR.

No. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes, because employers make hiring decisions.

## Career Search Guidance

### How should I approach writing an executive resume?
Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### What are common mistakes with writing an executive resume?
Common mistakes include being vague and generic. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### What is the first step in writing an executive resume?
Start with a clear goal. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### How long should I spend on writing an executive resume?
Spend focused time rather than endless hours. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### Can KOV Career Agency help with writing an executive resume?
KOV supports professionals through Private Career Representation and Individual Career Services. Scope is agreed before work begins. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### Is writing an executive resume different for senior professionals?
At senior levels, specificity and evidence matter more. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### Is writing an executive resume different for international searches?
Local conventions and work-authorisation rules matter. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### What should I avoid with writing an executive resume?
Avoid generic messages and unverified claims. Lead with measurable results and scope of responsibility, keep the design clean, and tailor the top third of the page to the role you want.

### How should I approach optimising a LinkedIn profile?
Use a specific headline, a clear About section and consistent experience entries so your profile tells one coherent professional story.

### What are common mistakes with optimising a LinkedIn profile?

### What is the first step in optimising a LinkedIn profile?

### How should I approach writing cover letters?
Keep a cover letter short and specific: why this role, why this organisation, and the two or three results most relevant to it.

### What are common mistakes with writing cover letters?

### What should I avoid with contacting recruiters?
Avoid generic messages and unverified claims. Send a short, specific message that states your target role, level and location, and attach a concise summary of your experience.
